sections.title: Inputs And Bend Table
sections.text: thickness required positive length. segments required nonempty array of {type:flat,length} and {type:bend,radius,angle,axis?,K?|allowance?}; every bend declares exactly one of K (K-factor in [0,1]) or allowance. fixedFace/reliefs/grain/process optional. representation external (default) or native; native is gated. schemaVersion required 1. Neutral radius is radius + K*thickness, or allowance/|angle| when an allowance is supplied; a bend missing both is rejected, so no allowance is guessed.

examples.label: Bend With K-Factor
examples.requires: Open Design document; a 90-degree bend of radius 2 mm with K-factor 0.5 and thickness 1 mm.
examples.output: result.bendTable[0].neutralRadius is 0.25 cm and developedLength is 0.25*pi/2 cm; result.bendCount is 1.

verified: neutral radius from K-factor or allowance

sections.title: Inputs And Forming
sections.text: thickness required; segments required flat/bend array. representation external (default) or native; native is reported blocked with nativeFlatPattern.available false, never faked as a static solid. schemaVersion required 1. The formed walk folds the neutral axis in 3D; the flat walk straightens bends, so developed and formed neutral lengths are identical and nothing is scaled. flat-to-formed correspondence is reported per segment.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'sheet.form',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,representation:'external',thickness,formedCenterline,formedMapping,flatCenterline,flatMapping,bendTable,totalDevelopedLength,correspondence,association,nativeFlatPattern}. representation native yields status blocked. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Form A Sheet Bracket
examples.requires: Open Design document; a flat-bend-flat bracket with an explicit K-factor.
examples.output: result.formedCenterline ends at [0, 0.25, 2.25] cm in the bend plane and result.totalDevelopedLength equals result.bendTable total; result.nativeFlatPattern.available is false.

sections.title: Inputs And Flattening
sections.text: thickness required; segments required flat/bend array. representation external (default) or native (blocked). schemaVersion required 1. The flat walk lays bends out straight by their developed length; developed length equals formed neutral length with no scaling. flat-to-formed correspondence and bend directions are reported. Flat-pattern DXF/SVG export is a documented gap.

examples.label: Flatten With Explicit Allowance
examples.requires: Open Design document; a 90-degree bend with a declared allowance equal to radius 2.5 mm times pi/2.
examples.output: result.totalDevelopedLength is 2 cm + 0.39269908169872414 cm and result.scaled is false.
